result.brief: 提出在冻结表征空间中回归critic输入梯度的对抗训练目标，实现图像与视频生成器的一步/少步采样，并适配14B级预训练视频生成模型。
result.reason: Trains adversarial objective in frozen representation spaces for one/few-step image and text-to-video generation, adapting large pre-trained video generators; directly serves video generation efficiency.
